description: Use this when the user asks how a bid Winquill is drafting is going, or wants to read it: its progress in steps and answers written, each question with its word count and Winquill's mark out of 5, what's left for the team to confirm, and the check of the whole bid. Give question to read that answer in full. Once it's ready, it gives a Word file link that works for an hour, and a link to the draft in Winquill. Needs a Winquill account. Example: {"tender_reference":"012345-2026"}

draft_id.description: The draft's ID, from start_bid_draft. Or give the tender's reference instead, or neither for the workspace's latest draft.

question.description: One answer to read in full, by the buyer's number, e.g. "Q3".

tender_reference.description: The notice ID, procurement identifier, solicitation number or the buyer's own reference, e.g. "012345-2026" on Find a Tender, "WS4851234567" on CanadaBuys or "140D0427Q0879" on SAM.gov.

workspace.description: The Winquill workspace to use, by name, when the user is in more than one, e.g. "Northbridge Services".

name: get_bid_draft

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working, in ISO 8601.

kind.description: "word" for the draft as a Word document.

step.description: questions, team, plan, write, mark, revise or ready; stopped when drafting stopped.

stepsDone.description: Steps done of steps: all of them once it's ready.

title: Check on Winquill's bid draft
